suggested_action.summary: Fix or remove broken internal links — each one is a dead end that ends a visitor's (or a browsing agent's) session on the spot.

findings.title: No discoverable XML sitemap
findings.evidence: /sitemap.xml returned status 403 and robots.txt has no Sitemap: line.

suggested_action.summary: Publish an XML sitemap (or sitemap index) covering canonical pages and reference it in robots.txt so crawlers can find and prioritize content efficiently.
Add a persistent navigation region with links to key sections (product, pricing, about, contact) so visitors — and agents browsing on a user's behalf — can orient and go deeper instead of leaving.
Add a robots.txt that explicitly allows crawling and points to the sitemap; its absence isn't fatal but removes a cheap, explicit signal of intent.
Add og:title, og:description, and og:image so link previews and summarization tools have a clean, authoritative source to quote.
Use a single <h1> per page and demote the rest to <h2>/<h3> to keep the outline unambiguous.

findings.title: Corroboration research not performed for this run
findings.evidence: No --search-results input was supplied, so cross-source agreement for this brand's key claims was not evaluated.

suggested_action.summary: Have the calling agent web-search 3-5 of the page's key factual claims (founding date, HQ, pricing, leadership) and re-run this check with --search-results to score corroboration.

findings.title: Proactive Opportunity: Add Speakable Specification for Voice AI Assistants
findings.evidence: Site contains substantial readable content (~3216 words analyzed), but lacks schema.org/Speakable specification.

suggested_action.summary: Add 'speakable' JSON-LD markup or CSS selector attributes pointing to your primary 1-2 sentence brand summary — this guides voice assistants (ChatGPT Voice, Siri, Google Assistant) to quote exact text.

findings.title: Proactive Opportunity: Link Entity to Wikidata/Wikipedia via sameAs
findings.evidence: No official Wikidata or Wikipedia sameAs identity link detected in Organization markup for flipkart.com.

suggested_action.summary: Include official Wikidata and Wikipedia URLs inside the Organization sameAs JSON-LD array for 'flipkart.com' to eliminate entity ambiguity across LLM knowledge bases.
